_doc: Project keys for tools/regress.py. Each key's workspace path is this machine's, in tests/patterns.local.json (git-ignored). Fixtures are game-derived C, so they live with each game: WORKSPACE/regress/fixtures.json, entries {id, pattern, addr, pass, fail}, pass = C a correct checker must PASS, fail = C it must FAIL (one semantic change, see fail_change), file names relative to that folder. "fixtures" here is for game-free ones only.
